full_judgment:
2. It appears from the report that the application for the certified copy of the impugned judgment and order dated 11-08-2009 passed in First Appeal No. 249 of 1997, was actually made on 27-1-2010 and the office of the High Court Division supplied it on 28-1-2010, to the petitioner. The Petition for Leave to Appeal enclosing the said certified copy raises the question of limitation. 

 3. Accordingly, the Leave Petition is dismissed as barred by limitation. 

 4. It further appears that the certified copy bearing the PC No. 941 of 2009 of the above noted judgment and order shows that the application for the same was shown to be made on 12-8-2009, on its first page although the enquiry discloses that the application for the certified copy was actually made on 27-1-2010. This fraud was practised obviously to save the period of limitation.
